summary: Invivyd, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results and an updated corporate presentation. The filing includes net product revenue of $13.7 million, 22% growth vs. Q1 2025, cash of $184.2 million, and DECLARATION trial updates for VYD2311. No special-situation transaction (e.g., merger, tender, spin-off) is described. This is a routine earnings and business update, not a transformative corporate event.
